title: citharexylum molle
intro: Citharexylum molle, commonly known as Guanacaste or Bahia Guanacaste, is a plant species native to the Americas, particularly in Mexico and Central America. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Citharexylum molle include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as arthritis, wounds, and oxidative stress. The plant contains bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
